hotels.title: Oceanfront Hawaii Glamour on Iconic Waikiki Beach with Infinity Pool
hotels.description: Discover the best of iconic Hawaii with a stay at ‘Alohilani Resort Waikiki Beach, perfectly positioned in the heart of Honolulu’s glamorous main beachfront promenade, Kalakaua Avenue. Admire the resort’s breathtaking oceanarium or visit SWELL, a sprawling, cabana-flanked infinity pool and bar offering panoramic views over the Pacific Ocean from its high floor elevation. The dining is top-notch - head to Morimoto Asia for a taste of the renowned Iron Chef’s masterful Asian plates, Piccola Onda for Italian bites served with a Roman flair or savour small-batch, artisanal scoops at Double Fat Ice Cream, Hawaii’s best-loved ice creamery.

hotels.title: Contemporary Honolulu Escape Near World's Largest Open-Air Mall with Two Onsite Restaurants
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in the tropical allure of Hawaii with a lavish stay at this stylish Honolulu abode, perfectly positioned beside the world's largest open-air shopping mall, the Ala Moana Centre. A short stroll from the glistening waters of the Pacific Ocean, the two-tower hotel features plush, well-appointed rooms and even a Starbucks in the lobby. In between exploring the vibrant Waikiki neighbourhood, cool off in the outdoor pool and soak up elegant views from the 36th-floor Signature Prime Steak & Seafood Restaurant. Work your way through high-end boutiques, surf shops and lively beach bars, or venture further afield to explore the historic Pearl Harbour or hike the scenic Diamond Head Crater, offering panoramic ocean vistas.

hotels.title: Hawaii Escape near Waikiki Beach & Kalākaua Avenue with Daily Breakfast & Daily US$25 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Set your clock to island time at Hilton Garden Inn Waikiki Beach, just a short stroll from the beach and the buzzing International Market Place. The trusted Hilton name brings standout service in a prime position for exploring Oʻahu’s most iconic neighbourhood. Start each day with a hearty Americana breakfast at TR Fire Grill, then swing by Holoholo Cafe & Market for locally roasted coffee and light bites on the go. After a day of coastal adventures, settle in at Shaka’s, the poolside bar, with a Mai Tai in hand. It's the perfect perch for watching the sun slip into a glowing Hawaiian sunset. Keep your routine going at the onsite fitness centre or trade it in for a scenic coastal walk with ocean views. Just five minutes away, Kalākaua Avenue hums with energy - a vibrant stretch where global flavours, designer boutiques and Hawaiian culture come together beneath swaying palms.

hotels.title: OUTRIGGER Reef Waikiki Newly Refurbished Beachfront Escape
hotels.description: Hawaii’s sun-drenched beaches, picturesque bays and towering volcanic peaks are nothing short of tropical bliss. Experience it all with an escape to the iconic OUTRIGGER Reef Waikiki Beach Resort, a much-loved beachfront hideaway in the heart of Waikiki. Perfectly positioned directly on Waikiki Beach, where the city meets the sea, OUTRIGGER Reef Waikiki Beach Resort is the place to be following a spectacular US$80 million refurbishment. Resort upgrades include a complete refresh of all guestrooms, an overhaul of the onsite restaurants and bars, plus a plethora of newly created wellness and fitness experiences, including state-of-the-art Peloton and Technogym equipment. A stay at this stylish oasis will leave you feeling reinvigorated, recharged and inspired.

hotels.title: Hawaii Tropical Bliss Steps from Waikiki Beach with Daily Breakfast & Outdoor Pool
hotels.description: Just steps from one of the world’s most iconic shorelines, OUTRIGGER Waikiki Beachcomber Hotel is Hawaii’s first and only craft hotel. Brought to you by the iconic OUTRIGGER Resorts & Hotels, curated by local artists and reflecting Hawaii's unique natural landscapes and rich culture, this stylish retreat is an iconic destination set right on Kalakaua Avenue - Honolulu's vibrant shopping and entertainment precinct. A standout entertainment feature, the onsite Cirque du Soleil’s 'Auana brings breathtaking acrobatics, side-splitting comedy, live music and hula dancers together in a dazzling celebration of Hawaii’s spirit - and a 10% discount means you'll be perfectly placed to savour the spectacle. Be sure to take advantage of the hotel's glorious outdoor pool for a refreshing dip. Grab a well-deserved pint at Maui Brewing Co. - an incredible craft brewery and bar, offering local beers, artisan cocktails and island cuisine - and savour locally grown Kona coffee and acai bowls at Hawaiian Aroma Caffe, Waikiki’s most Instagrammable coffee shop.

hotels.title: Hawaii Big Island Family Resort by Outrigger with Spa & Multi-Level Pool
hotels.description: Discover the magic of Hawaii at Outrigger Kona Resort and Spa, a family paradise on the sun-kissed shores of Hawaii's Big Island. This idyllic retreat is a stone's throw from vibrant Kailua-Kona town, brimming with historic sites and oceanfront dining. Kids and grown-ups alike will love the multi-level fantasy pool with a 200-foot water slide, manta-ray viewing and sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean. Hit the spa to relax and as the sun sets, savour the flavours of Hawaii at the resort's Wailele Café.

hotels.title: Outrigger Waikiki Beachfront Escape
hotels.description: If you’re chasing sun, sand, shopping and tropical bliss, Outrigger Waikiki Beach Resort is the place to be. A stay at this modern beachfront haven is sure to leave you feeling well-rested and relaxed. Catch some rays at the shimmering pool, drop by Infinity Spa for moments of indulgence or break a sweat at the fitness centre. When hunger strikes, savour some of Oahu's favourite dining at popular Duke's Waikiki, pick up a tropical smoothie at Sunrise Shack, stop by at Pai's Deli for healthy sandwiches or take in magnificent views of Diamond Head at Hula Grill Waikiki. Take part in the many activities available at the hotel, including stand-up paddleboard yoga, flower lei making and surfing. For adventures beyond your idyllic oasis, spend your days shopping on Kalakaua Avenue's fashion mile, hiking the trails at Diamond Head, uncovering the history of Pearl Harbor, or admiring the scenery at Manoa Falls.

hotels.title: Verdant Hawaiian Island Luxury Residences with Oceanfront Golf Course & Infinity Pool
hotels.description: Retreat to a glorious Hawaiian island oasis, where the grass is greener, the water is clearer and the drinks are sweeter, with a stay at Timbers Kaua'i Ocean Club & Residences. Embrace the classic laidback and vibrant culture of Hawaii while admiring panoramic views of the turquoise ocean stretching out from the front door. Spend your days exploring nearby beaches and tropical forests, floating in the incredible two-tiered infinity pool or rejuvenating in Nanea Spa. Tee off at The Ocean Course, a Jack Nicklaus Signature, to soak up the longest stretch of oceanfront golf in Hawaii. Take your tastebuds on a delicious adventure to the Garden Isles with fresh farm-to-table dishes served up at Hualani’s Restaurant, finishing with a refreshing cocktail at the poolside bar.

hotels.title: Award-Winning Waikiki Boutique Hideaway near Kalākaua Avenue with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Named among Hawaii's top 10 hotels by readers of Condé Nast Traveller, Wayfinder Waikiki brings a design-forward sensibility to one of the world's most famous beach strips. Mid-century lines meet island textures as local art brightens corridors and common spaces in this hotel; on opening, Vogue magazine called Wayfinder Waikiki 'the most beautiful hotel opening in 2023.' A landscaped pool courtyard with cabanas and a hot tub offers island-style relaxation. Three Hawaiian-operated venues fill the day from first coffee to last call. B-Side Coffee Bar opens early with locally roasted pours and pastries, neighbourhood favourite Redfish Poke Bar handles Hawaiian-inspired seafood and seasonal produce, and the poolside speakeasy, Lost + Found, takes over come evening with handcrafted cocktails and a mood to match its surroundings. Waikiki Beach is a short walk away, while Kalākaua Avenue's boutiques, the surf breaks of Queen's Beach, Kapiolani Park and Honolulu Zoo are all within easy reach. A hotel that more than earns its place on these coveted shores.
